title: Data Classification adds 50 new classes and support for 16 more countries and regions
body:
Data Classification now detects 50 new classes of sensitive data, along with new regional support for 16 countries and regions:

* **Payment card and financial data**: Card security codes, card expiration dates, card track data, card PINs, SWIFT codes, and credit scores.
* **Personal and employee data**: Gender, residency status, disability data, sexual data, street addresses, geographic coordinates, compensation, and employment status.
* **Software security secrets**: Credentials and secrets used by software.
* **Regional identifiers**: Added 35 new classes and expanded coverage in existing classes across 18 countries and regions, including China, Mexico, the UK, other European countries, and more. See [the documentation](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/data-classification-tags#regional-tags) for details.

Regional tags are available in select regions. See [Supported classification tags](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/data-classification-tags).
